name: O'Hare Precision
verdict: With zero spend and zero leads across Meta and Google Ads in the last 28 days, paid channels are completely inactive, making GBP the sole source of engagement with 188 total actions (13 calls, 121 directions, 54 web clicks). The biggest concern is GBP actions dropping 50% week-over-week, likely driven by reduced organic search visibility or seasonal demand softening.

performance.verdict: Paid channels dormant; GBP declining fast and now the only revenue signal.

findings.text: Zero paid spend and zero leads across all 28 days — Meta and Google Ads are fully dark, producing no pipeline whatsoever.

OVERDUE (Jul 7, Jul 28, Jul 31): CRM 1st Directives, Tom call-list priority flag, and dedup workbook + 126 accounts delivery show no completion event — 342 stub accounts still unreconciled, blocking Sales-i sync.
GBP actions dropped 50% week-over-week; last 3 days (Aug 22–24) averaged 1.7 actions vs prior 3 days (Aug 19–21) average of 8.7 — a confirmed 3-day deterioration, not noise.

Search clicks fell 14% week-over-week; last 3 days (Aug 22–24) averaged 5.0 clicks vs prior 3 days (Aug 19–21) average of 23.3 — directional alignment with GBP drop suggests organic visibility softening.
GA4 sessions are zero for all 28 days — tracking is almost certainly broken; 414 search clicks and 188 GBP actions with zero sessions recorded is not plausible organically.

suggestions.text: Fix GA4 tracking — 414 search clicks and 188 GBP actions with 0 sessions recorded means zero visibility into site behavior.
suggestions.monday_update: GA4 is recording zero sessions across all 28 days despite 414 search clicks and 188 GBP actions in the same window — the tag is either missing or misfiring. Dev team to audit GA4 tag installation and confirm firing on key pages. Success is confirmed when daily sessions are non-zero and directionally match search click volume. Complete audit by 2026-08-28.

suggestions.text: Escalate 3 overdue CRM milestones — 342 stub accounts block Sales-i sync and pipeline visibility for all 5 entities.
suggestions.monday_update: Three milestones are overdue: 1st Directives (Jul 7), Tom call-list priority (Jul 28), and dedup workbook + 126 accounts delivery (Jul 31). The 342 unreconciled stub accounts are actively blocking the Sales-i → Sugar data pipeline, meaning no inactivity or decline signals reach the CRM. Ahmed to confirm status of each item and post rollback-ready batch file to the Monday CRM board. All three must show a completion event by 2026-09-01.

suggestions.text: Watch GBP for 3 more days — last 3-day average of 1.7 actions vs 8.7 prior; confirm sustained drop before escalating.
suggestions.monday_update: GBP actions have dropped 50% week-over-week and the last 3-day average (Aug 22–24) is 1.7 vs 8.7 in the prior 3 days (Aug 19–21). Search clicks are also down 14% week-over-week. No paid activity is masking or amplifying this — GBP is the sole engagement channel. Re-check on 2026-08-28; if the 3-day average remains below 5 actions, escalate to an SEO/GBP content review.
